description: This line plot illustrates the relationship between "Sample Token Count" and "Shared Experts for Two Samples" across six different categories. The x-axis, labeled "Sample Token Count," uses a base-2 logarithmic scale ranging from $2^9$ to $2^{20}$, with tick marks placed at every consecutive power of 2. The y-axis, labeled "Shared Experts for Two Samples," uses a linear scale ranging from 2.0 to 6.0, with tick marks spaced at intervals of 0.5. The plot contains six solid lines without markers, distinguished by color according to a legend in the bottom right corner. The coral line, representing "Intent," begins at approximately 3.8 at $2^9$, dips to roughly 3.9 at $2^{11}$, rises sharply to 5.2 at $2^{12}$, and then steadily increases to end at 6.0 at $2^{20}$. The blue line, representing "Summary," starts at 1.9 at $2^9$, rises sharply to 4.7 at $2^{11}$, dips slightly to 4.5 at $2^{12}$, and then climbs steadily to end at approximately 5.9 at $2^{20}$. The gold line, representing "Law," starts at 3.6 at $2^9$, rises to a peak of 5.1 at $2^{11}$, drops to 4.6 at $2^{12}$, rises to another peak of 5.8 at $2^{14}$, and ends near 6.0 at $2^{20}$. The purple line, representing "Translation," starts at 5.1 at $2^9$, rises to 5.3 at $2^{10}$, drops to 4.7 at $2^{11}$, and then generally increases to end at 5.9 at $2^{20}$. The grey line, representing "Code," begins at 1.9 at $2^9$, remains relatively flat until $2^{10}$, rises to 3.7 at $2^{13}$, experiences a sharp decline to 3.1 at $2^{14}$, and then increases steadily to end at 5.8 at $2^{20}$. Finally, the green line, representing "Math," starts at 3.8 at $2^9$ and exhibits a steady, continuous upward trend across the entire x-axis, ending at approximately 6.0 at $2^{20}$.
